# n3 - Per-node worktrees and their lifecycle

`NodeWorktree` gives a work node its own worktree at
`<repo>/.claude/worktrees/<id>--<slug>--<node>` on branch `plastic/<id>--<slug>--<node>`, cut from
the intent branch tip. Verify, research and decision nodes get none: they produce no diff, so a
worktree would only give them somewhere to write one.

The lifecycle runs through the failure states, not only the happy one (C31, D32): provisioned at
`running`, merged into the intent branch and removed at `done`, kept at `failed_verification` and
`needs_decision` so the evidence survives, removed at `superseded` and `abandoned`.

`Worktree` stays intent-scoped and untouched, with one exception the plan review found:
`NodeWorktree` does not reuse `Worktree.merge_branch`, which resolves its target as the main
checkout's current branch and would merge node work straight into `alpha`. The merge runs as
`git -C <intent worktree> merge --no-ff <node branch>` and reports conflicted paths from
`git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` before aborting.

`WorktreeSweep` is not taught node branches either: it globs the store-worktree tree intent 178
retired. `NodeWorktree` carries its own reaper over `<repo>/.claude/worktrees/`.

## n3 failure-mode matrix
| Row | Operation | Failure mode | Test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3.1 | Derive the node worktree path and branch | Two nodes of two intents collide on one path and each sees the other's files | `node_worktree_test#test_path_and_branch_include_intent_and_node` |
| 3.2 | Cut the node branch from the intent branch tip | The node branches from `alpha` and its merge drags in every unrelated commit since | `node_worktree_test#test_branch_is_cut_from_intent_branch_tip` |
| 3.3 | Reuse an existing node worktree instead of erroring | A retry cannot provision and the node can never run a second attempt | `node_worktree_test#test_provision_is_idempotent` |
| 3.4 | Give a verify node no worktree | A verify node gets somewhere to write a diff, which is exactly what C4 forbids | `node_worktree_test#test_verify_node_gets_no_worktree` |
| 3.5 | Give a research node no worktree | Same, for research | `node_worktree_test#test_research_node_gets_no_worktree` |
| 3.6 | Fail open when the repo is unresolvable or not a git repo | A global-store-only intent raises instead of running its nodes without a worktree | `node_worktree_test#test_non_git_repo_fails_open` |
| 3.7 | Merge the node branch into the intent branch, in the intent worktree (D24, meld of blocker 6) | `Worktree.merge_branch` targets the main checkout's current branch, so node work lands on `alpha` and the intent branch never gets it | `node_worktree_test#test_merge_targets_intent_branch_in_intent_worktree` |
| 3.7a | Refuse to merge when the intent worktree is on the wrong branch | The merge lands wherever the worktree happens to be checked out | `node_worktree_test#test_merge_refuses_wrong_checked_out_branch` |
| 3.8 | Remove the worktree after a clean merge | Orphan worktrees accumulate and every later `/clear` errors | `node_worktree_test#test_done_removes_worktree_after_merge` |
| 3.9 | Keep the worktree on `failed_verification` | The retry loses the failing tree and nobody can see what the executor actually wrote | `node_worktree_test#test_failed_verification_keeps_worktree` |
| 3.10 | Keep the worktree on `needs_decision` | The owner is asked about a conflict whose evidence has already been deleted | `node_worktree_test#test_needs_decision_keeps_worktree` |
| 3.11 | Remove the worktree on `superseded` and `abandoned` | A dead node's worktree is never cleaned and its branch stays in `git worktree list` | `node_worktree_test#test_terminal_states_remove_worktree` |
| 3.12 | Abort the merge and report the conflicted paths from `--diff-filter=U` | A conflicted merge is left in the tree and the next step aborts on `MERGE_HEAD` forever | `node_worktree_test#test_conflict_aborts_merge_and_names_paths` |
| 3.12a | Return the conflicted paths, not a bare boolean | D8 cannot route inside versus outside `files:` and every conflict gets the same treatment | `node_worktree_test#test_conflict_result_carries_paths` |
| 3.13 | Report the diff paths between the intent branch and the node branch | The diff-scope check in n4 has no input and every node passes it | `node_worktree_test#test_changed_paths_lists_node_branch_diff` |
| 3.14 | Report an empty diff as empty, not as an error | A verify node with no diff is treated as a failure and no verify node can ever pass | `node_worktree_test#test_empty_diff_is_empty_not_error` |
| 3.15 | Reap a terminal node's worktree from `<repo>/.claude/worktrees/` (D26, meld of blocker 8) | `WorktreeSweep` globs the retired store-worktree tree and derives a `plastic-store/` branch, so it can never see a node worktree and orphans accumulate | `node_worktree_test#test_reaper_removes_terminal_node_worktree` |
| 3.16 | Spare a node branch with unmerged commits | Unmerged work is deleted by a routine sweep | `node_worktree_test#test_reaper_keeps_unmerged_node_branch` |
| 3.17 | Spare a worktree whose node is not terminal | A running or parked node loses the tree it is working in | `node_worktree_test#test_reaper_spares_non_terminal_node` |
| 3.18 | Leave every non-node worktree in that directory alone | The reaper removes the intent worktree, or another intent's, because the name pattern is too loose | `node_worktree_test#test_reaper_ignores_non_node_worktrees` |
| 3.19 | Register `node_worktree.rb` in `core_files` (D25) | `install_sync_test` goes red as soon as a `scripts/*` file requires it | `install_sync_test#test_core_files_match_disk` |

## Steps
1. Red: the matrix's tests above, committed before any code.
2. Write `NodeWorktree`, including its own merge and its own reaper.
3. Green, then the whole suite at its baseline.
